newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian stock market indices hit new highs.
newsitem.headline: Italian stock market indices hit new highs.

text.p: The Milan bourse's key indices, the all-share Mibtel and the blue chip Mib30, rose to new all-time highs in early trading on Wednesday.
The Mib30 jumped 1.01 percent to 21,657 and the Mibtel rose 0.97 percent to 14,241.
The Fib30 stock index September futures contract soared to a new record high of 21,830 from a close on Tuesday of 21,631. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
